function.description:
Read the shared seed, chemical, fertilizer, fuel and grain stock.

All farms draw from these same quantities. Machine tanks and hoppers
are reported by the machine, and each farm reports its own water quota
and applied-material limits through get_management_status.

Returns:
    Warehouse identity, remaining consumables, pending/stored grain kg
    and common storage/drying limits. Grain quantities follow each crop's declared mass and moisture basis.
function.name: Warehouse__get_inventory

function.description:
Read every common-warehouse grain batch and its origin and moisture.

Returns:
    Batches with batch_id, origin_farm_id, crop, cultivar, ridge IDs,
    quantity_kg, moisture_pct, pending/stored status and dried flag.
    Pass the batch_id to dry_grain or store_grain.
function.name: Warehouse__get_grain_batches

function.description:
Dry one pending grain batch to a safe moisture without advancing time.

Already safe batches are left unchanged. Drying capacity is shared by
all farms and counted cumulatively per calendar day. Stored or
unknown batches fail. Grain quantities retain the crop's declared market-moisture basis.

Args:
    batch_id: Exact pending batch ID returned by get_grain_batches.
    target_moisture_pct: Target percentage in [11,16], no greater than
        the common facility and origin crop's storage moisture limits.

Returns:
    Updated batch or an error with no batch or capacity changes.
function.name: Warehouse__dry_grain

batch_id.description: Exact pending batch ID returned by get_grain_batches.

target_moisture_pct.description: Target percentage in [11,16], no greater than the common facility and origin crop's storage moisture limits.

function.description:
Admit one pending batch into common long-term grain storage.

Requires known moisture at or below the facility and origin crop's
storage limit, and sufficient remaining common storage capacity.
No time advances; repeated admission is rejected without changing kg.

Args:
    batch_id: Exact pending batch ID returned by get_grain_batches.

Returns:
    Stored batch and total common warehouse grain kg, or an error.
function.name: Warehouse__store_grain

batch_id.description: Exact pending batch ID returned by get_grain_batches.

function.description:
Return a concise farm summary: current date, season phase, inventory,
required_field_preparation_ops and actual completed preparation,
and a per-ridge overview (key fields only, not full detail).

season_phase indicates the current stage of the agricultural calendar:
  "prep"     — pre-planting field preparation
  "planting" — active sowing window
  "growing"  — crop vegetative and reproductive growth
  "harvest"  — grain maturity and harvesting

Use get_ridge_state() or get_ridge_range_state() for full ridge detail.
function.name: MaizeFarm__get_farm_overview

function.description:
Return an operational state lookup for one ridge.

Includes planting status, seed type, growth stage, days since planting,
grain moisture, estimated yield potential, and days since pesticide application.

nutrient_index is an indicative crop-condition value, not a measured soil
nitrogen concentration. A low value alone does not establish a nutrient
deficiency; assess crop stage and other field evidence before fertilizing.

Args:
    ridge_id: Ridge identifier within the configured farm.
function.name: MaizeFarm__get_ridge_state

ridge_id.description: Ridge identifier within the configured farm.

function.description:
Wait one day and update the field conditions.

This advances time by 24 hours; it is not a refresh at the current time.
Use SystemApp.advance_time for a different duration. If daily field
updates are inactive, this call reports no action.
function.name: MaizeFarm__commit_daily_physics

function.description:
Apply nutrient and carrier water to a ridge range.

nutrient_amount is a dose multiplier: 1.0 uses 30 kg of fertilizer
product per treated ridge. Total product use is 30 x nutrient_amount
x the number of treated ridges.
``water_mm`` is the per-ridge carrier-water depth; it consumes the
irrigation quota and enters the soil water balance.

Args:
    start_ridge:     First ridge (within the configured farm).
    end_ridge:       Last ridge (within the configured farm, inclusive, >= start_ridge).
    nutrient_amount: Positive dose multiplier; 1.0 uses 30 kg of product per treated ridge.
    water_mm:        Carrier-water depth per treated ridge in mm (>=0); consumes water allowance.
function.name: MaizeFarm__apply_fertigation

end_ridge.description: Last ridge (within the configured farm, inclusive, >= start_ridge).

nutrient_amount.description: Positive dose multiplier; 1.0 uses 30 kg of product per treated ridge.

water_mm.description: Carrier-water depth per treated ridge in mm (>=0); consumes water allowance.

nutrition.fertilizer_kg: fertilizer product mass; elemental composition is unspecified
nutrition.nutrient_index: dimensionless availability proxy, not a soil N/P/K measurement
nutrition.scope: no explicit N/P/K mass balance or mechanistic nitrogen fixation

function.description:
Return readings and actual coverage of this farm's soil probes.

Each probe reports volumetric water content (vwc) and soil temperature
(temp_c) at 5 cm depth. The reading represents the average condition
of the ridges within the sensor's coverage zone.

Probe count and coverage depend on the configured farm layout.
Each result includes sensor_id, ridge_start and ridge_end; the
sensor listing provides the local IDs for single-probe reads.

Bound farm: maize_field.

function.description:
Return readings and actual coverage of this farm's canopy sensors.

Each sensor reports an ndvi_proxy value (0.0-1.0). A value of -1
means no valid reading yet (pre-emergence). The reading represents
the average canopy condition within the sensor's coverage zone.

Probe count and coverage depend on the configured farm layout.
Each result includes sensor_id, ridge_start and ridge_end; the
sensor listing provides the local IDs for single-probe reads.

Bound farm: maize_field.

function.description: Attach one implement actually owned by this tractor. Detach the currently mounted implement before switching.

Remove the currently mounted implement from this shared tractor.

Fails if there is no mounted implement. No farm parameter is required;
the mounted implement belongs to this tractor.

Returns:

function.name: Tractor__detach_implement

function.description:
Transfer fuel from the shared warehouse into this tractor's fuel tank.

Requires positive liters and sufficient warehouse fuel; transfer is capped by the 100 L
tank capacity. Fuel remains available to subsequent work on any registered farm.

Args:
    liters: Requested transfer volume in liters; must be positive.

Returns:
    Warehouse ID and fuel level, or an error.
function.name: Tractor__refuel

liters.description: Requested transfer volume in liters; must be positive.

function.description:
Transfer pesticide from the shared warehouse into the shared spray tank.

Requires positive liters and sufficient stock; transfer is capped by the 800 L tank
capacity. Loaded pesticide can be used on any registered farm.

Args:
    liters: Requested transfer volume in liters; must be positive.

Returns:
    Warehouse ID and spray tank level, or an error.
function.name: Tractor__refill_pesticide_tank

liters.description: Requested transfer volume in liters; must be positive.

function.description:
Load fertilizer from the shared warehouse into the shared spreader.

Requires positive kilograms and sufficient stock; transfer is capped by the 500 kg
spreader capacity. Loading does not consume a farm's fertilizer quota;
actual application counts against the selected target farm.

Args:
    kg: Requested fertilizer mass in kilograms; must be positive.

Returns:
    Warehouse ID and spreader level, or an error.
function.name: Tractor__load_fertilizer

kg.description: Requested fertilizer mass in kilograms; must be positive.

function.description: Transfer the selected seed from the bound warehouse into this tractor's seed hopper. The hopper holds one seed type at a time, with a capacity of 300,000 seeds; transfers are capped by free space. Field crop compatibility is checked when sowing.

count.description: Positive seed count; transfer is capped by hopper capacity.

seed_type.description: Seed identity accepted by this loading point.

function.description:
Read this shared tractor's fuel, payload, implement and grain batch origin.

Loaded supplies can be used on any registered farm. Grain from different
farms must be unloaded into separate batches before harvesting another farm.

Returns:

function.name: Tractor__get_status

function.description:
Level and till the selected farm with the shared tractor.

Requires the grader implement, trafficable soil and fuel proportional to field area (8 L on the reference 64-ridge field). Advances all registered farms by
the full-field operation duration and records preparation only on the selected farm.

Args:
    farm_id: Target farm ID from the environment farm directory; ridge IDs are local to
        this farm.

Returns:
    Operation result or error; farm operations include the target farm_id.
function.name: Tractor__level

farm_id.description: Target farm ID from the environment farm directory; ridge IDs are local to this farm.

function.description:
Spread base fertilizer over the selected farm with the shared tractor.

Fertilizer and fuel scale with target field area: the reference 64-ridge
field (268 m length, 1.1 m ridge width) needs 200 kg and 8 L. Requires
trafficable soil. Advances all registered farms by the operation duration
and records preparation only on the selected farm.

Args:
    total_kg: Positive total fertilizer product mass; omitted uses the selected field's area-scaled default.
    farm_id: Target farm ID from the environment farm directory; ridge IDs are local to
        this farm.

Returns:
    Operation result or error; farm operations include the target farm_id.
function.name: Tractor__base_fertilize

farm_id.description: Target farm ID from the environment farm directory; ridge IDs are local to this farm.

function.description: Form ridges using attached 'furrower'. Requires an unplanted field; terminate an existing crop through a supported operation first. The spacing must equal the selected field's configured geometry. maize_field (maize): ridge spacing 0.65 m. soybean_field (soybean): ridge spacing 1.1 m.

farm_id.description: Registered target farm; all ridge IDs and crop rules are local to it.

function.description:
Fertilize an inclusive ridge range on the selected farm.

Covers at most 10 ridges per pass. Requires positive dose, enough loaded fertilizer, length-scaled fuel (2 L per 268 m pass) and trafficable soil. Advances all registered farms; fertilizer effects belong to the
selected ridges.

Args:
    farm_id: Target farm ID from the environment farm directory; ridge IDs are local to
        this farm.
    start_ridge: First local ridge ID, inclusive, starting at 0.
    end_ridge: Last local ridge ID, inclusive; must be inside the target farm and within
        the per-pass limit.
    kg_per_ridge: Fertilizer dose per ridge in kilograms; must be positive.

Returns:
    Operation result or error; farm operations include the target farm_id.
function.name: Tractor__apply_fertilizer

end_ridge.description: Last local ridge ID, inclusive; must be inside the target farm and within the per-pass limit.

farm_id.description: Target farm ID from the environment farm directory; ridge IDs are local to this farm.

kg_per_ridge.description: Fertilizer dose per ridge in kilograms; must be positive.

start_ridge.description: First local ridge ID, inclusive, starting at 0.

function.description: Sow the target field; up to 4 contiguous ridges per pass. maize_field (maize): requires attached 'maize_planter'; completed preparation: level, base_fertilize, form_ridges; Depth 3–6 cm; target-block average soil temperature >= 10 °C; target-block average soil VWC 0.18–0.35; Density 0.01–30 plants/m²; Seed use follows 268 m ridge length and 1 planted row(s) per ridge; Observe the field's planting window. soybean_field (soybean): requires attached 'soybean_planter'; completed preparation: level, base_fertilize, form_ridges; Depth 3–5 cm; target-block average soil temperature > 10 °C (seed exceptions: EARLY_COLD: >= 8 °C); target-block average soil VWC 0.2–0.35; Seed use follows 268 m ridge length and 2 planted row(s) per ridge; Observe the field's planting window.

seed_spacing_cm.description: Positive in-row seed spacing in cm; resulting density must satisfy the target crop's rule.

function.description:
Unload this tractor's grain bin into a new shared warehouse batch.

Transfers the entire bin, preserves its farm and ridge provenance, clears
the bin's origin and advances all farms by 480 seconds. No farm selection
is needed: the harvest records already identify the grain's origin.

    batch_id: Unique nonempty ID for the new grain batch. Existing IDs are rejected.

Returns:
    Warehouse batch details and emptied grain bin, or an error.

function.description:
Return all remaining seeds, fertilizer and chemicals to the shared warehouse.

Fuel stays in the shared tank. Pesticide and fungicide both return to the
warehouse chemical pool. Loading and returning supplies do not consume
any farm's application quota. No time passes during this transfer.

Returns:
    Warehouse ID and returned quantities.
function.name: Tractor__return_supplies

function.description:
Survey the specified farm using this shared drone.

Reads only the target farm's crop and weather conditions, and updates
only its observed NDVI and canopy temperature. Consumes this drone's
shared battery and advances time for every farm. Flight is refused while
charging, below its minimum battery, or in unflyable weather. A low
battery can stop the mission between passes, leaving partial coverage.

Args:
    farm_id: Exact target farm ID from the available farm directory.
    start_ridge: First local ridge ID in that farm, starting at 0.
    end_ridge: Last local ridge ID, inclusive; must be at least start_ridge
        and less than that farm's num_ridges.

Returns:
    Farm-qualified mission ID, surveyed ridges, NDVI/temperature readings,
    elapsed minutes and remaining battery. Status partial and a warning
    identify incomplete coverage; error reports a refused mission.
function.name: Mavic3M__fly_survey

function.description:
Walk one ridge of the selected farm and report pest/disease presence.

Consumes 20 percentage points of this robot's shared battery and advances
every farm by the round-trip walking time. Refused during charging or
with less than 20 percent battery available for the full trip. Wet weather
produces a ground-wet warning. Species identification depends on the target field's diagnostic
capabilities. Detections may be uncertain; read confidence where provided.
An unavailable diagnosis is not confirmed absence of a problem.

Args:
    farm_id: Exact target farm ID from the available farm directory.
    ridge_id: Local ridge ID, from 0 to that farm's num_ridges - 1.

Returns:
    Farm-qualified inspection, pest/disease diagnostic, shared remaining
    battery and optional wet-ground warning, or error if refused.
function.name: Robot0__inspect_ridge

farm_id.description: Exact target farm ID from the available farm directory.

ridge_id.description: Local ridge ID, from 0 to that farm's num_ridges - 1.

function.description:
Inspect a local ridge range for pests using this shared ground robot.

Detections have uncertainty. A mission visits at most eight ridges,
limited by remaining battery. Unvisited ridges remain uncovered. Each ridge consumes
5 battery percentage points, leaving at least 10 percent for return.
Advances all farms by round-trip walking time per covered ridge.
Charging or starting battery below 15 percent refuses the inspection.
Unavailable diagnoses remain unknown.

Args:
    farm_id: Exact target farm ID from the available farm directory.
    start_ridge: First local ridge ID in that farm, starting at 0.
    end_ridge: Last local ridge ID, inclusive; at least start_ridge and
        less than that farm's num_ridges.

Returns:
    Farm-qualified observations, covered and uncovered ridge IDs,
    shared remaining battery and wet-ground warning when applicable.
    Status partial means some requested ridges were not inspected.
    Unavailable weed evidence is reported as unknown; error reports
    a refused inspection.
function.name: Robot0__inspect_pests

function.description:
Inspect pest/disease/weed presence and stand fraction in one target farm.

Detections have uncertainty. A mission visits at most eight ridges,
reduced by remaining battery. Each covered ridge consumes 5 battery percentage points, leaving at least
10 percent for return. Advances time for every registered farm.
Charging or starting battery below 15 percent refuses the inspection.
Unavailable diagnoses remain unknown. Combine symptoms with soil and
weather evidence before deciding on treatment.

    farm_id: Exact target farm ID from the available farm directory.
    start_ridge: First local ridge ID in that farm, starting at 0.
    end_ridge: Last local ridge ID, inclusive; at least start_ridge and
        less than that farm's num_ridges.

Returns:
    Farm-qualified observations, covered/uncovered local ridge IDs,
    shared battery and optional ground-wet warning. Status partial means
    incomplete coverage; error means refused. Missing evidence is unknown.
function.name: Robot0__inspect_crop_health

function.description:
Inspect emergence stand fraction in the specified farm's ridge range.

Read current visible-stand estimates and the observation's source and
coverage. A mission visits up to eight ridges, limited by battery.
Unavailable stand evidence must not be treated as confirmed crop failure.
Each covered ridge consumes 5 battery percentage points, leaving at least
10 percent for return. Advances time for every registered farm.
Charging or starting battery below 15 percent refuses the inspection.

Args:
    farm_id: Exact target farm ID from the available farm directory.
    start_ridge: First local ridge ID in that farm, starting at 0.
    end_ridge: Last local ridge ID, inclusive; at least start_ridge and
        less than that farm's num_ridges.

Returns:
    Farm-qualified stand fractions and detections, covered/uncovered
    local ridge IDs and shared battery. Status partial means incomplete
    coverage; error means refused. Ground-wet warning may be present.
function.name: Robot0__inspect_emergence
